synonyms: ディアボリックラヴァーズ
description: Komori Yui is an optimistic young lady that has a strong connection with her father. When he allegedly has to travel for work purposes, Yui is sent to what she thinks is the residence of some distant family members. She is immediately greeted by six strange young gentlemen, the Sakamaki brothers, all of whom want one thing from Yui--her blood. Yui must learn to adapt to life while being a constant target of six forceful vampires, as well as uncover Sakamaki family secrets and information about her role and identity.

Ayato is the 5th child and the youngest of the triplet of the fraternal twins (the others being Kanato and Raito). He is a prankster and a very narcissistic boy, always claims to be number #1 in everything. He also has a passion for torture devices; such as the Iron Maiden that can be found in his room, which he uses as a bed (the spikes are removed). It is also noted that he eats a lot (only if it is his favorite food takoyaki and gets very angry if someone eats his food), although Ayato stated that vampires need to drink blood to savor the taste.   

~! He's been raised by knowing the only rule as "never failing in order to be loved", therefor he got used to always be perfect as that was a synonym for him to be worthy of love. Whenever he would've failed, his mom taught him that the punition would've been abuse and cruelty. All of this made him being the narcissistic person he is now. Obviously he never got a sane motherly love, he was only used by Cordelia to gain the attention to be noticed by her husband. He eventually grew to resent how his mom threated him, and tried to kill her once. In truth all of the attention he needs to have is due his deep need of love. !~   

He's voiced by Midorikawa Hikaru in the Drama CD.

The 1st and eldest child in the family. Apathetic and lazy, Shuu is someone who loves nothing but music. He's now somewhat bored with life due to all that happened in his past. Despite Shuu is the eldest son he doesn't take any responsiblity to look after his five brothers and the house at all, he mostly pushes this job all to Reiji.   ~! Since he was the eldest son, despite having all the attentions, he was always alone until he met Edgar, a human in a nearby village, who soon became his best and only friend. When Edgar died, due the big fire in the village, Shuu felt it like he was unable to save him and blamed himself. He's still unaware that the fire was set up by his brother Reiji out of jealousy. Because of his past experience, Shuu tends to push Yui away a lot, at first, as he says that humans die too easily. !~  He's voiced by Toriumi Kousuke in the Drama CD.

The 4th child in the family and the middle child of the triplet of the fraternal twins (the others being Ayato and Raito). He is modeled after the yandere archetype and very mercurial. Kanato seems mentally unstable, kinda child-like as he can burst into tears and screaming whenever he can't get what he wants and then suddenly turning back to normal, often telling you it was all an act and that you're stupid for believing him. He speaks politely but is abusive and clingy.   ~! His disturbed child-like personality is given to the fact that, like his brothers, he wasn't properly raised, as his mom was used to have sex with other persons right in front of him, when he was a kid. Since anyone could have her but him, when she died and he found her dead body, he burned it and stuffed the ashes in his bear plush so that now his mom belongs to him only. Also, Kanato is used to talk with his bear right because "his mom's ash is in it". !~

Subaru is the 6th child, thus being the youngest of all the brothers.  He's a delinquent type, kinda violent and loves to damage things. He's also a sadist, but despite all, can occasionally be sweet. Subaru, of all, doesn't get along to any of his brothers.   ~! Around sixteen years prior the storyline, Christa, Subaru's mom, was forced into become a bride and was then raped. Subaru is the fruit of that rape, in fact he, like his mother, is kinda "broken" by this. His mother, everytime that sees Subaru, always begs him to kill her, but he's never capable to do that. She also gave him a knife able to kill vampires in order to get her own death. This is pretty much the reason as why he is permanently angry and breaks things. Subaru grew up without a the love of a mother, always hearing her screaming by desperation. !~  He is voiced by Kondo Takashi in the Drama CD.

The 3rd child and the oldest triplet of the fraternal twins (the others being Kanato and Ayato).  He's a pervert and sadist vampire, and like Kanato, is a scary and insane type.  He's also quite rude as he calls Yui insulting names.   ~! Cordelia raised her son, Raito, in an extremely sick way; as it was the "norm" to have sex with him. In time, Raito got used to doing these things, and began to view his mother as more of a lover than his parent. As she was quite the flirty type, Raito would most likely kill anyone he'd caught sleeping with her. When Raito's father found out about the unusual relationship between his wife and son, he locks Raito in the basement. Later Cordelia goes to see him and tells him that she is now having sex with someone else, and that all this time, she has only used Raito for sex. Since he saw her as a lover, he couldn't avoid looking at things like she was cheating on him. The shock and the situation overall made Raito ending up becoming a pervert. At some point in the story, when Cordelia was attacked by Ayato and ran to Raito for help, he threw her off the balcony in response. !~  He's voiced by Hirakawa Daisuke in the game and the Drama CD.

Reiji is the 2nd son in the family.  He is a very strict type.  Reiji is the one who takes care of the household and of all his younger brothers while Shuu, who is the one supposed to be doing this, slack off. Because of Shuu's lazy behaviour, Reiji hates him and is jealous of his position of eldest son of the family as Shuu gets all the attention. Even though he's usually gentle, he insults Yui terribly, yet he's also a sadist vampire.    ~! Reiji hired a vampire hunter to kill his mother and show her that he was better than Shuu. Due to the jealousy towards Shuu he also did set on fire an entire village, only to kill Shuu's human friend, Edgar. Shuu is still unaware of this though. Reiji has a collection of poisons and is experimenting a drug to bring his mom back to life (just to kill her again). !~

Komori Yui is a normal girl who gets sent, by her father, to the Sakamaki brothers' house. She is a good-natured and sweet girl. Her dad works in a Church and she has the power to see ghosts.  
~! Despite she is technically human, she has Cordelia's heart so is more like a dormant vampire. She is unaware of this though.!~

Cordelia was an abusive and promiscuous woman who would use anyone, including her own children, in order to be acknowledged by her husband. She is shown to be very manipulative, seeing as how she was able to convince Richter that she would make him the leader of the vampires if he resurrected her.

She is also a very cocky and arrogant person, who believes everything should work in her favor. She doesn't react well when things go against her wishes and with that arrogance, she does everything to get what she wants and would not hesitate to hurt her children or the other mothers.

In addition to this, she was also very strict and abusive to her children. She is commonly known to be the very woman who caused mental (and physical) damage to the triplets. Cordelia is also very flirty. She often flirts in front of the triplets and even goes as far as to having sexual affairs in their presence. It is also revealed that she really didn't want to have children in the first place.

Richter appears to many as lovesick and can be very pretentious shown as he will do anything Cordelia asks him to do just to gain her love and attention. Richter can show a few signs of being arrogant in someways as shown when he compares his strengths and powers to that of the Sakamaki brothers.
She is one of the three mothers that had married Mr. Sakamaki. Christa is the mother of Subaru.
